system.description:
No longer just a control system, but also the command center. If you select this component, replace the cockpit with it.

Navigation (Heart & Mind): Make a Power Roll to navigate without fast travel. On a success navigate the ship to your next destination without interference.

Docking (Heart & Mind): If the ship is in melee range to another non-hostile spacecraft or docking station make a Power Roll to safely dock on.

Ram (Fist): Make an Attack Roll against a target. On a success spend an Armor Slot to ram a target within melee range. The target takes d12 kinetic damage and gets pushed into Close range.

Docking (Heart & Mind): Make a Power Roll to take cover with your ship in a Far range area. As long as the spaceship is covered you can reduce the incoming damage by one threshold.
system.gmNotes: The card prints the fourth feature as "Docking (Heart & Mind)"; its text describes taking cover.

attribution.source: The New Unknown Playtest v3.0 Fist
